Rendered isolation failed for this voice -- 8 MusicGen takes across 3 prompt strategies, none a struck hit (every take a slow-rising sustained texture; envelope peaks at 0.7-2.8 s, no attack transient anywhere in the field) -- so the founder's fallback clause stands this sample in its place. Measured by the house scales on arrival: single hit region, 0.175 s decay, tail -69.7 dB rel peak, sustain -70.9 dB, decays fully within the file. Its tonality reads 0.925: that is the TR-808 hat's own metallic partial stack (six fixed square-wave oscillators), not melodic bleed -- stated so the number is never mistaken for the failure it convicted in the rendered takes.
